title: Production Guarantee Schedule — SunPath Solar Lease
content:
Each SunPath Solar Lease guarantees a share of the system's estimated production in every lease year. The figures below are the guarantee terms of each system size; they are the figures the annual production reconciliation reads.

## Definitions

1. **Guaranteed share** — the production guaranteed each lease year, as a percent of the estimated production for that year.
2. **Yearly degradation** — the yearly reduction in estimated production after the first lease year, in percent.
3. **Credit per kWh** — the credit, in US dollars, for each kWh of shortfall below the guaranteed production.
4. **Annual credit cap** — the most the production guarantee credit can amount to for one lease year, in US dollars.
5. **Reconciliation period** — the number of months in each production reconciliation period.

## Schedule of guarantee terms

| Tier | Guaranteed share | Yearly degradation | Credit per kWh of shortfall | Annual credit cap | Reconciliation period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 90 percent | 0.5 percent | $0.31 | $400.00 | 12 months |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 90 percent | 0.5 percent | $0.31 | $500.00 | 12 months |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 90 percent | 0.5 percent | $0.31 | $600.00 | 12 months |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 92 percent | 0.5 percent | $0.31 | $700.00 | 12 months |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 92 percent | 0.5 percent | $0.31 | $800.00 | 12 months |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 95 percent | 0.5 percent | $0.31 | $1000.00 | 12 months |

## Notes on the schedule

- The guaranteed share steps up with size: 90 percent for the three smallest systems, 92 percent for the SunPath 5.6 kW and SunPath 6.4 kW systems, and 95 percent for the SunPath 8.0 kW system.
- The credit per kWh of shortfall and the yearly degradation are the same for every size; the annual credit cap differs by size, rising from $400.00 to $1000.00.
- With a 12-month reconciliation period, each period is one lease year.
